title: Brochure
subtitle: 「小冊子／宣傳冊／資料冊」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「小冊子／宣傳冊／資料冊」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 brochure 非常接近，尤其指較薄、頁數少、常摺疊的宣傳或資訊材料。
words.example: The hotel gave us a leaflet about local attractions.
words.exampleZh: 酒店給了我們一張介紹本地景點的宣傳單。

exercises.original: The hotel gave us a brochure about local attractions.
exercises.zh: 酒店給了我們一張介紹本地景點的宣傳單。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel gave us a leaflet about local attractions.

options.explanation: 短篇旅遊介紹資料和 brochure 很接近。
通常系統列出大量項目，篇幅更長。
是展示用海報，不是手持小冊。

exercises.original: Visitors can pick up a brochure at the information desk.
exercises.zh: 訪客可在詢問處取一份資料單張。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors can pick up a leaflet at the information desk.

options.explanation: information desk 派發短篇資料非常自然。

exercises.original: The charity produced a short brochure explaining its services.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構製作了一份簡短單張介紹服務。
exercises.upgrade: The charity produced a leaflet explaining its services.

options.explanation: short 是強線索，簡短資訊材料很適合 leaflet。
通常用於學校、課程或投資等正式介紹。

words.note: 指篇幅短、裝訂簡單的資訊或宣傳小冊子。
words.example: The clinic provides a pamphlet explaining the treatment.
words.exampleZh: 診所提供一本小冊子解釋治療方法。

exercises.original: The clinic gave patients a brochure about the treatment.
exercises.zh: 診所給病人一本介紹治療方法的小冊子。
exercises.upgrade: The clinic gave patients a pamphlet about the treatment.

exercises.original: The campaign distributed brochures explaining its position.
exercises.zh: 該活動派發小冊子解釋其立場。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign distributed pamphlets explaining its position.

options.explanation: pamphlet 很常見於宣傳、倡議、資訊說明。

exercises.original: The museum published a small brochure about the artist's life.
exercises.zh: 博物館出版了一本介紹藝術家生平的小冊子。
exercises.upgrade: The museum published a pamphlet about the artist's life.

options.explanation: 簡短介紹性小冊非常自然。
若列出大量作品才更適合。

words.note: 非常自然，通常指有多頁、較完整的小冊。
words.example: The museum produced a booklet for visitors.
words.exampleZh: 博物館為訪客製作了一本小冊子。

exercises.original: The museum produced a brochure containing twenty pages of visitor information.
exercises.zh: 博物館製作了一本二十頁的訪客資料小冊。
exercises.upgrade: The museum produced a booklet containing twenty pages of visitor information.

options.explanation: 多頁小冊最適合用 booklet。

exercises.original: Every participant received a brochure with detailed programme information.
exercises.zh: 每位參加者都收到一本包含詳細活動資料的小冊。
exercises.upgrade: Every participant received a booklet with detailed programme information.

options.explanation: detailed 表示內容較完整，多頁 booklet 很自然。

exercises.original: The conference brochure included maps, schedules, and speaker biographies.
exercises.zh: 會議小冊子包括地圖、時間表和講者簡介。
exercises.upgrade: The conference booklet included maps, schedules, and speaker biographies.

options.explanation: 內容多而完整，很符合 booklet。
可能太短，不足以容納如此多內容。

words.note: 通常指單頁或非常簡短的宣傳材料。
words.example: Staff handed out flyers advertising the event.
words.exampleZh: 工作人員派發宣傳活動的傳單。

exercises.original: Staff handed out brochures advertising the concert.
exercises.zh: 工作人員派發宣傳音樂會的傳單。
exercises.upgrade: Staff handed out flyers advertising the concert.

options.explanation: 單頁、促銷、派發是 flyer 的典型語境。

exercises.original: The café printed a simple brochure offering a 20% discount.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店印製了一張提供八折優惠的宣傳單。
exercises.upgrade: The café printed a flyer offering a 20% discount.

options.explanation: 可以較長，但此處 simple discount sheet 更像 flyer。

exercises.original: Volunteers distributed brochures announcing the community event.
exercises.zh: 義工派發傳單宣傳社區活動。
exercises.upgrade: Volunteers distributed flyers announcing the community event.

words.meaning: 派發資料；講義；資料單張
words.note: 指在活動、課堂、會議、展覽等場合派給參加者的印刷資料。
words.example: Each visitor received a handout describing the exhibition.
words.exampleZh: 每位訪客都收到一份介紹展覽的資料單張。

exercises.original: Everyone at the seminar received a brochure summarizing the key points.
exercises.zh: 研討會每位參加者都收到一份總結重點的派發資料。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone at the seminar received a handout summarizing the key points.

options.explanation: 研討會現場派發的資料最自然叫 handout。

exercises.original: The guide gave visitors a brochure with a map of the site.
exercises.zh: 導遊給訪客一份附有場地地圖的資料單張。
exercises.upgrade: The guide gave visitors a handout with a map of the site.

options.explanation: 在現場派給訪客的資料很自然。

exercises.original: The workshop brochure included a short exercise and contact details.
exercises.zh: 工作坊派發資料包含一項短練習及聯絡資料。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop handout included a short exercise and contact details.

options.explanation: 工作坊資料＋練習內容是典型 handout。

words.note: 比單獨 leaflet 更明確表示用途是提供資訊。
words.example: Please read the information leaflet before using the product.
words.exampleZh: 使用產品前請先閱讀資料單張。

exercises.original: Please read the brochure before taking the medicine.
exercises.zh: 服藥前請閱讀資料單張。
exercises.upgrade: Please read the information leaflet before taking the medicine.

options.explanation: 醫療／產品資訊中非常自然。
重點是促銷，不適合用藥資訊。

exercises.original: The council published a brochure explaining the new recycling rules.
exercises.zh: 市政部門出版了一份解釋新回收規則的資訊單張。
exercises.upgrade: The council published an information leaflet explaining the new recycling rules.

options.explanation: 公共服務資訊單張很典型。
通常是教育／投資等正式簡章。

exercises.original: Passengers received a brochure about safety procedures.
exercises.zh: 乘客收到一份有關安全程序的資料單張。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers received an information leaflet about safety procedures.

options.explanation: 重點是提供資訊，不是推廣。

words.note: 表示較完整、多頁的資訊資料。
words.example: New students receive an information booklet during orientation.
words.exampleZh: 新生在迎新期間會收到一本資料小冊子。

exercises.original: New students receive a brochure with detailed campus information.
exercises.zh: 新生會收到一本詳細校園資料小冊。
exercises.upgrade: New students receive an information booklet with detailed campus information.

exercises.original: The hospital gave patients a brochure covering appointments, meals, and visiting hours.
exercises.zh: 醫院給病人一本涵蓋預約、膳食和探訪時間的資料冊。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital gave patients an information booklet covering appointments, meals, and visiting hours.

options.explanation: 內容多項、完整，適合 booklet。

exercises.original: The programme brochure explains all the available support services.
exercises.zh: 計劃資料冊解釋所有可用支援服務。
exercises.upgrade: The programme information booklet explains all the available support services.

options.explanation: 完整服務資料適合多頁小冊。
只強調廣告，不一定提供完整資料。

words.note: 強調推廣、促銷或吸引客戶。
words.example: The company distributed promotional leaflets in the shopping centre.
words.exampleZh: 公司在商場派發宣傳單。

exercises.original: The company handed out brochures promoting its new service.
exercises.zh: 公司派發宣傳單推廣新服務。
exercises.upgrade: The company handed out promotional leaflets promoting its new service.

options.explanation: 短篇＋推廣目的完全吻合。
若列完整產品線才較適合。

exercises.original: A brochure advertising the opening discount was placed in every mailbox.
exercises.zh: 每個信箱都收到一張宣傳開幕優惠的單張。
exercises.upgrade: A promotional leaflet advertising the opening discount was placed in every mailbox.

options.explanation: 郵箱派發＋折扣宣傳很典型。
若大量列產品才較自然。

exercises.original: The gym produced a brochure to attract new members.
exercises.zh: 健身中心製作了一份宣傳單吸引新會員。
exercises.upgrade: The gym produced a promotional leaflet to attract new members.

options.explanation: 吸引新客戶是典型 promotional purpose。
申請表可用於入會，但不是宣傳材料。

words.note: 指較完整、以推廣產品、服務或機構為目的的小冊子。
words.example: The developer produced a promotional booklet for the new apartments.
words.exampleZh: 發展商為新公寓製作了一本宣傳小冊子。

exercises.original: The developer produced a glossy brochure for the new apartment project.
exercises.zh: 發展商為新公寓項目製作了一本精美宣傳冊。
exercises.upgrade: The developer produced a glossy promotional booklet for the new apartment project.

options.explanation: 地產＋多頁＋精美推廣非常符合。

exercises.original: The resort brochure contains photographs, room descriptions, and package details.
exercises.zh: 度假村宣傳冊包含照片、房型介紹和套票詳情。
exercises.upgrade: The resort promotional booklet contains photographs, room descriptions, and package details.

options.explanation: 內容完整又以促銷為目的。

exercises.original: The car company sent customers a brochure presenting the new model range.
exercises.zh: 汽車公司寄給顧客一本介紹新車系列的宣傳冊。
exercises.upgrade: The car company sent customers a promotional booklet presenting the new model range.

options.explanation: 產品系列宣傳、圖片和介紹非常典型。
通常不是一次性完整產品介紹。

words.note: 在學校、大學、課程、投資等特定正式語境中，可和 brochure 很接近。
words.example: The university sent me its undergraduate prospectus.
words.exampleZh: 大學寄給我本科課程簡章。

exercises.original: The university sent me a brochure describing its undergraduate courses.
exercises.zh: 大學寄給我一本介紹本科課程的簡章。
exercises.upgrade: The university sent me its undergraduate prospectus.

options.explanation: 大學課程與招生介紹最典型。
可能列課程，但 prospectus 更正式、更自然。

exercises.original: Prospective students can download the school's brochure online.
exercises.zh: 準學生可在網上下載學校簡章。
exercises.upgrade: Prospective students can download the school's prospectus online.

options.explanation: 申請表不是完整介紹資料。

exercises.original: The college brochure explains courses, fees, entry requirements, and facilities.
exercises.zh: 學院簡章介紹課程、學費、入學要求和設施。
exercises.upgrade: The college prospectus explains courses, fees, entry requirements, and facilities.

options.explanation: 招生資料範圍完整，最自然。

words.note: 在博物館、景點、城市或活動場地中，可替代介紹性 brochure。
words.example: Pick up a visitor guide at the entrance.
words.exampleZh: 請在入口處取一本訪客指南。

exercises.original: Pick up a brochure at the museum entrance.
exercises.zh: 請在博物館入口取一本訪客指南。
exercises.upgrade: Pick up a visitor guide at the museum entrance.

options.explanation: 博物館入口提供的導覽資料很自然。
如果列出展品才可能適合，但一般訪客資訊更像 guide。

exercises.original: The city brochure includes maps, transport tips, and recommended sights.
exercises.zh: 城市訪客指南包括地圖、交通提示和推薦景點。
exercises.upgrade: The city visitor guide includes maps, transport tips, and recommended sights.

options.explanation: 城市旅遊資訊的功能和 guide 完全吻合。

exercises.original: Visitors receive a brochure explaining the historic site's main features.
exercises.zh: 訪客會收到一本介紹歷史景點主要特色的訪客指南。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors receive a visitor guide explaining the historic site's main features.

options.explanation: 參觀場所導覽用途最自然。
通常用於教育／投資等正式介紹。

falseSynonyms.zh: 目錄不等於宣傳冊 catalogue 通常系統列出大量產品、作品或項目，篇幅往往比 brochure 長。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The brochure introduces the resort. The catalogue lists every product and model.

falseSynonyms.zh: 海報不等於小冊子 poster 是大型單張展示材料，不是可翻閱的小冊。
廣告不等於 brochure brochure 可以是一種 advertising material，但 advertisement 的範圍更廣，包括電視、網上、報紙廣告等。
操作手冊不等於介紹冊 manual 的核心是詳細操作／使用指示，不是簡短介紹或宣傳。
通訊不等於 brochure newsletter 通常定期出版，提供最新消息；brochure 通常是較固定的介紹資料。
餐牌不等於 brochure 即使餐廳 brochure 可能介紹餐飲服務，menu 的功能是列出菜式和價格。
表格不等於資料冊 form 是讓人填寫資料的文件。
形式範圍不同 - brochure = 通常有設計感、資訊＋推廣 - leaflet = 較薄、簡短 - booklet = 多頁小冊，不一定推廣
